{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Keep only the latest sample for each patient
df_latest = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the full distribution of biomarker_baseline
biomarker_stats = df_latest['biomarker_baseline'].describe()
print("Biomarker baseline statistics:\n", biomarker_stats)

# Check for negative values explicitly
negative_count = (df_latest['biomarker_baseline'] < 0).sum()
print("\nNumber of negative biomarker_baseline values:", negative_count)

# Check the minimum value
print("\nMinimum biomarker_baseline value:", df_latest['biomarker_baseline'].min())"}
